figure.title: Figure 9 (continued). Variation with lift coefficient of the aerodynamic characteristics for wing 4. (b) Drag coefficient.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, on staggered scales. Common axis = the M = 0.50 scale: left frame line = -0.2 (label '-.2'), grid every 0.1 (33 vertical lines, about 62.4 px apart), right frame line = 3.0. The row of labels under the Mach strip reads '-.2' and then '0' thirteen times, one under every second grid line from common 0.0 to 2.4, each below its Mach number in the strip 'M = 0.50 .70 .85 .90 .925 .95 .975 1.00 1.02 1.035 1.085 1.10 1.121', then '.2 .4 .6' of the M = 1.121 scale at common 2.6, 2.8 and 3.0 (the right frame).
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D (common to all Mach numbers). Grid every 0.01 from 0 (the top line of the Mach label strip) to 0.20 (top frame line, label '.20'); labels every 0.02. The C_D = 0 line is not printed right of about common 2.5 (NACA logo box).
figure.content_note: Wing 4 (47 deg sweep, thickened root: 12 percent at the root to 6 percent at 40 percent semispan, 6 percent outboard). One faired polar per Mach number, 13 Mach numbers, hollow symbols with a centre dot, one shape per Mach number: circle 0.50, square 0.70, diamond 0.85, triangle 0.90, inverted triangle 0.925, triangle pointing right 0.95, triangle pointing left 0.975, right triangle with horizontal top and vertical left side 1.00, right triangle with horizontal top and vertical right side 1.02, right triangle with vertical left side and horizontal bottom 1.035, right triangle with vertical right side and horizontal bottom 1.085, D-shape (horizontal top, vertical left side, curved lower right) 1.10, mirrored D-shape (horizontal top, vertical right side, curved lower left) 1.121. Shapes were tied to Mach numbers by following each faired curve to its minimum near its own C_L = 0. Only M = 0.50, 0.85, 0.95, 1.00 and 1.10 are read here. Repeated and odd symbols: M = 0.50 has three overlapping circles at C_L about 0.41 (two dots visible, the third dot hidden), and one symbol at C_L about 0.06 drawn as two concentric circles (radii about 8.5 and 13.5 px, the usual circle is about 11 px) with a single centre dot, counted once. Where the order of two symbols at the same C_L is a tie, they are listed by increasing C_D.

calibration.x_definition: Common axis = the M = 0.50 C_L scale (its zero is the third vertical line from the left frame, under the first '0'). Each Mach number's C_L = 0 is the grid line above its '0' label: M 0.50 at 0.0, 0.70 at 0.2, 0.85 at 0.4, 0.90 at 0.6, 0.925 at 0.8, 0.95 at 1.0, 0.975 at 1.2, 1.00 at 1.4, 1.02 at 1.6, 1.035 at 1.8, 1.085 at 2.0, 1.10 at 2.2, 1.121 at 2.4. Reported C_L = common-axis value minus x_offset.
